mvp_description: AI-powered marina slip waitlist and booking confirmation system for waterfront facilities
summary: The marina MVP targets marina and waterfront facility operators in Ashtabula County, Ohio, a region with significant Lake Erie maritime activity. The MVP provides a waitlist management and booking confirmation system that could benefit from white-label deployment. Ashtabula Harbor alone boasts 11 marinas and yacht clubs along the Ashtabula Riverfront. The area has a mix of private yacht clubs, full-service marinas, and municipal port authorities managing hundreds of boat slips. Primary competitors in the marina booking space include Dockwa and Snag-A-Slip. The white-label opportunity is strong for this MVP, as the modular design can be easily adapted for any marina or waterfront facility.

leads.name: Harbor Yacht Club & Marina
leads.fit_rationale: Private marina with seasonal dock openings. Currently offers dockage and actively markets seasonal openings. The MVP's waitlist system would help them manage seasonal slip turnover and waitlists for prospective members.
leads.source: City of Ashtabula marinas directory + web search

leads.name: North Coast Marina & Campgrounds
leads.fit_rationale: Large facility with 250 boat slips, 32 campground sites, pool/spa, and full amenities. They already use Dockwa for online reservations, showing they invest in marina management technology. A white-label waitlist system could complement their existing Dockwa integration or provide a branded alternative for direct bookings.

leads.name: Ashtabula Yacht Club
leads.fit_rationale: Established 1924, 150+ members, 125 docks accommodating 24'-50' powerboats and sailboats. Recently invested in infrastructure (35-ton travel lift, 600+ feet of bulkhead replacement). As a member-owned club with limited dock space, they would benefit from a waitlist system for prospective members and dock assignments.
leads.source: City of Ashtabula marinas directory + website

leads.name: Ashtabula County Port Authority
leads.fit_rationale: Government entity managing the Port of Ashtabula with a transient dock facility. They offer free sanitary pump-out station and daytime docking. The MVP could be adapted for their transient dock reservations and public facility management. They focus on economic development and may be interested in modernizing harbor services.
leads.source: Ashtabula County official website + web search

leads.name: Port Conneaut Marina / Conneaut Port Authority
leads.address: Conneaut, OH (Lake Erie, Ohio's northeastern corner)
leads.fit_rationale: 400-slip marina managed by Conneaut Port Authority. Recently partnered with Oasis Marinas Management (June 2024) for professional management, indicating openness to modern marina solutions. Ashtabula County's second major port facility, representing significant regional opportunity.

branding_quality_assessment.notes: The MVP shows a nautical-themed design with blue and orange palette appropriate for marina services. The 'Harbor Marina' branding is generic. The modular card-based layout makes it highly adaptable for any marina or waterfront facility. The AI GENERATED badge should be removed for production use.
